basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old automotive enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I recently purchased my first Toyota Tacoma and have been diving into the world of aftermarket modifications. Outside of my interest in trucks, I work as a software engineer at a tech startup. I enjoy spending my evenings gaming and exploring new food spots in town. I'm single and usually online during late evenings after work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and a deep interest in automotive customization. I've gained my knowledge through a combination of online tutorials, community forums, and hands-on experience.
